result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): I counted every text in both answers and all are under 160 characters (A: 137/129/125/132; B: 136/132/134/134), and neither adds any facts. B wins because its four take different approaches: a plain reminder, one stating the fee, a warm version, and one 'holding your slot' with the notice policy. Three of A's four are the same reminder with a reworded fee line. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): I counted every text by hand, and all eight are under 160 characters. Answer A's stated counts are exact, while Answer B labels its counts approximate and is off by one on #2 (129, not ~130). Answer A's four texts take clearly different approaches: plain, fee-focused, warm, and notice policy plus phone. Three of Answer B's four use the same pattern of reminder, C/R and $45 fee with only the wording changed. Both answers keep the facts right and the tone neutral, though both extend the late-cancel fee to rescheduling ('changes', 'changed'), which the policy doesn't clearly say.
